reuse.why: Both link rules and the Fintegra link route through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and the unlink reset is extracted into a helper reused by unlinkAccount, but the Fintegra download follows the tree's per-provider copy pattern instead of a shared download helper.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (token, post, error mapping, response shaping), while the link-side logic is not duplicated.

placement.why: The duplicate-link and closed-account rules live in the shared linkBankSyncAccount, the provider download in sync.ts and the endpoint in server-config, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps; the extraction of clearAccountBankLink is needed to share the unlink behaviour.

maintainability.why: Rules sit in one place that every provider uses, though another copy of the download boilerplate and a growing provider if-chain add to the existing copy debt.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in accounts/sync.ts is an openly copied version of downloadAkahuTransactions, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink; the closed-account and already-linked checks are general rules applying to every provider, and all six link handlers (including fintegra) call it.
